items.text: Bon Jovi's "Livin' on a Prayer" spent four weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, one of the two longest-running number-one singles of 1987.
items.question: Where were you living when Bon Jovi's "Livin' on a Prayer" was on the radio, and who in your life turned it up?
items.source_quote: These are the Billboard Hot 100 number-one hits of 1987. The longest running number-one singles of 1987 are "Livin' on a Prayer" by Bon Jovi and "Faith" by George Michael which each logged four weeks at number one.

items.text: In October 1987, the Minnesota Twins defeated the St. Louis Cardinals to win the World Series.
items.question: Who did you watch the 1987 World Series with, and were you rooting for the Twins or the Cardinals?
items.source_quote: October 25 – 1987 World Series: The Minnesota Twins defeat the St. Louis Cardinals despite having the worst regular season win–loss ratio for a winner, a record they hold until 2006.
